# F16: New goal fits a phone: first field and Continue on the first screen, no step over two screens, 44 px controls (F16)

A check of the core ([the journeys](../journeys.md)): not a journey with steps a person takes, but a script that opens pages and reports what is wrong (Faro’s `evals/finish/11-new-goal-phone.cjs`). A rebuild proves the same by hand or with its own script: every failure below must not happen. Each is in the script’s words; {…} is what it measured.

## What it checks

New goal on a phone (onboarding spec, section 6; OB1). At 390 × 844 and 360 × 800, on each of the four steps: the step's first field and its primary button are on the first screen with the keyboard closed; no step is taller than two screens (the measure step with the plan table folded); every control is at least 44 px high, "Change" included; nothing scrolls sideways; nothing covers Back or Continue, and the tab bar doesn't show (focus mode). Set-up's steps join this check with OB3.
